description.value: The Britannia General Store is a boutique community hub in Britannia Beach, operated by The Boatshed Group and designed with a nod to the area's historic copper mining heritage through rustic décor and vintage touches. It stocks fresh groceries, liquor, handmade pizza, and local goods, making it a convenient one-stop resupply point on the Sea-to-Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. Touring cyclists riding Highway 99 will find it right in the heart of Britannia Beach village.
